description.value: GM Restaurant is an Indian restaurant in the Lower Mainland serving authentic curries, award-winning house-made cheesecake, and artisan chai teas. It operates as both a dine-in and takeout establishment, with delivery available through major apps and a branded retail spice-and-tea line called Shah Foods. The kitchen explicitly accommodates vegan and gluten-free requests.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Indian restaurant with explicit takeout ordering, delivery via major apps, catering, and a direct statement accommodating vegan and gluten-free diners. No bike-specific amenities (rack, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi) are mentioned on the website or in OSM tags. Two phone numbers appear on the website but no physical address is visible in either the OSM record or the fetched content, making location verification impossible.
concerns: No physical address in OSM record or discoverable from fetched website content — location cannot be verified.
OSM name is 'gm Restaurant' (lowercase g); website renders it as 'Gm Restaurant' in the title and 'GM Restaurant' throughout body copy.
Two phone numbers found on website ((604) 463-7877 and (604) 463-7899); neither is present in OSM. First number used in phone field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate, operating restaurant with confirmed takeout and dietary accommodations useful to cyclists, but no physical address is available in OSM or the website content, and none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states 'Looking for Vegan Options? How about gluten free? No matter what, we're sure we can accommodate you and help you build a meal' that suits dietary needs
